geometry.positions: x,z in{.125,.25,.375},y0; ID3*ix+iz; center(.25,0,.25). Dyadic coordinates and velocities.

geometry.cell: Actual MakeDivDataGpu one-cell layout: empty boundary range and fluid range[0,9). No neighbour-loop replacement.

independent_reference.moment: Host double sum M_ab=-sum(volume*dr_a*rawGradW_b) at center; raw fac uses actual host kernel with float h/rr2/fac contract. Check positive/isotropic Mxx,Mzz and cross cancellation at64DBL_EPSILON*max(1,|M|). Supply Cxx=Czz=1/mean(Mxx,Mzz),Cyy1 and zero offdiagonal to actual force kernel.
independent_reference.limitation: This intentionally supplies known isotropic C; does not test GPU general matrix inversion/tracking or affine accuracy of incomplete-support outer nodes.
velocity_trials: simple_shear: vx=.5(z-.25),vz0,trace0 and positive nonempty center xz stress rate
independent_reference.theta_gate: Each center ON result finite and |theta-trace|<=64FLT_EPSILON*max(1,|trace|), fixed before execution. Both signs of nonzero trace must remain nonempty.
independent_reference.pore_gate: Center closed rate matches -(Kw/n)*trace under same64FLT_EPSILON scaled budget; actual drained center FSType2+hydrodrainfs true must have exactly zero pressure rate while nonzero dilation/compression theta persists.

matrix.cases: Five velocity trials x center closed/drained =10 cases.
matrix.calls_per_case: Actual force OFF with NULL theta and nonzero diagnostic sentinel, then two ON calls, each with caller-cleared physical outputs and caller-zeroed theta (matches production reset convention).
matrix.all_node_outputs: 270 rows=10cases*3stages*9nodes in node_outputs.csv; center known trace only, outer nodes not claimed affine-exact.
matrix.physical_OFF_ON_pairs: 180 native node pairs, all ar/pore-rate/viscdt/ace XYZ/stress-rate six component bytes identical; physical input velocity/density, stored stress/pressure and supplied correction unchanged.
matrix.pointer_null: 90 node diagnostic sentinel checks ensure a NULL observer pointer writes nothing.
matrix.reset: 90 per-node ON1/ON2 theta byte pairs; independent caller reset keeps repeat-stage output identical, no accumulated stale theta.
matrix.nonempty: 8 nonzero-trace ON center checks,4 drained nonzero-theta/zero-rate center checks,4 nonempty shear-stress center checks.
